title: 7 дней Sri Lanka Highlights с отелями 4 ЗВЕЗДЫ и частным трансфером
seoTitle: 7 дней Sri Lanka Highlights с отелями 4 ЗВЕЗДЫ и частным трансфером | Hai Sri Lanka
metaDescription: Private 7-day Sri Lanka tour: Sigiriya, Pidurangala, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella train, Yala safari, Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, and Bentota.
shortDescription: Sigiriya to Yala in seven days - culture, tea hills, safari, and south coast with 4 STAR hotels and a private driver.
overview:
A seven-day private journey from the Cultural Triangle to the south coast. Climb Pidurangala Rock, join a village tour, and unwind with Ayurveda, then climb Sigiriya Lion Rock and enjoy an elephant safari at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park.
Continue through Dambulla and Kandy into tea country, Horton Plains, and the Ella train, then a jeep safari at Yala National Park. Finish with Mirissa whale watching or snorkeling, Galle Fort, a turtle hatchery, and a Bentota boat ride before hotel or airport drop-off.

seo.metaTitle: 7 дней Sri Lanka Highlights с отелями 4 ЗВЕЗДЫ и частным трансфером | Hai Sri Lanka
seo.metaDescription: Private 7-day Sri Lanka tour: Sigiriya, Pidurangala, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella train, Yala safari, Mirissa whale watching, Galle Fort, and Bentota.

itinerary.title: Airport / Hotel – Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Travel inland to Sigiriya. Climb Pidurangala Rock, join a village tour, and unwind with an Ayurveda massage before overnight in Sigiriya.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Climb Sigiriya Lion Rock, then a jeep safari at Minneriya, Kaudulla, or Hurulu Eco Park. Overnight at the same hotel.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya – Kandy
itinerary.description: Leave the Triangle via Dambulla Cave Temple and Matale Spice Garden, then Upper Lake Drive, a gem museum, Kandyan cultural dance, and the Temple of the Tooth Relic.

itinerary.title: Kandy – Nuwara Eliya
itinerary.description: Climb toward the tea hills with Ambuluwawa Tower, a tea plantation and factory visit, and a Nuwara Eliya city tour.

itinerary.title: Nuwara Eliya – Ella
itinerary.description: Early-morning trek in Horton Plains National Park, then continue to Ella by scenic train through the hills.

itinerary.title: Ella – Yala
itinerary.description: Descend toward the plains with a stop at Ravana Falls, then a safari at Yala National Park.

itinerary.title: Yala – Airport / Hotel
itinerary.description: Coastal finale along the south: Mirissa whale watching or snorkeling with whales or sea turtles, Galle Fort, a Bentota boat ride, and a turtle hatchery before drop-off to the airport or your hotel.

faqs.question: Can the itinerary be customized?
faqs.answer: Yes. We tailor pace, hotels, and experiences — for example Ayurveda time or safari timing — to your preferences.

faqs.question: Is whale watching seasonal?
faqs.answer: Mirissa whale watching is typically best from November to April. Outside peak season we suggest snorkeling with sea turtles or other coastal alternatives.
